title: Isolating and culturing dendritic cells \(Dendritic Cell J558 Protocol)
protocol: Expand cells in selection medium without exceeding 1.5 – 2 x 10^6 cells.
Wash cells twice in medium without G418.
Freeze cells at 5 x 10^6 per ampoule with 90% FCS and 10% DMSO.
Thaw a vial by washing in medium without G418 once.
Inoculate a 175 cm² flask in 50 ml of medium with 5% FCS without G418.
Seed cells into 500 ml of medium with 5% FCS without G418 at 2 x 10^5 cells/ml when enough cells are present, approximately after 3 days.
Collect conditioned medium by centrifuging culture for 5 min at 1300 rpm after 3 more days.
Filter the supernatant through a 0.22 μm filter.
Re-seed cells at 2 x 10^5 cells/ml in about 3 L of medium with 5% FCS without G418 for further conditioned medium production.
Collect conditioned medium as above after another 3 days.
Rebuild a 3-day conditioned medium with cells recovered.
Discard the cells after use.
Keep the conditioned medium at 4°C for up to 4 months.
Aliquot and freeze the conditioned medium at -80°C for longer storage.
Ensure GM-CSF concentration in ELISA is more than 20 ng/mL.
Do not filter the supernatant more than once.
Prepare Complete Iscove’s Modified Eagle's Medium (IMEM) by adding:
5 mL of Pen/Strep.
5 mL of L-glutamine.
0.5 mL of β-mercaptoethanol.
Heat inactivate Special DC FCS from South American origin, tested best for DCs.
Add 50 mL of the heat-inactivated FCS to IMEM.
Combine with GM-CSF as required.
Use Ike's frozen FBS aliquots for the preparation.
